analytic_input.application: for f in Gamma_c(F), choose a Cauchy slice strictly to the past (respectively future) of supp(f), solve L_WC u=f with zero Cauchy data there, and use uniqueness to make the result independent of the chosen slice
analytic_input.finite_propagation: the symmetric-hyperbolic domain of dependence is contained in the metric causal domain because every characteristic speed has absolute value at most one
analytic_input.theorem: global existence, uniqueness and finite propagation for linear symmetric-hyperbolic systems on globally hyperbolic spacetimes; equivalently the symmetric-hyperbolic case of Bär, Green-hyperbolic operators on globally hyperbolic spacetimes, Commun.
